package model

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/LIghtJUNction/api.lmm.best/common"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"gorm.io/driver/postgres"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
	"gorm.io/gorm/logger"
)

// Synthetic test-only probe. The capability-one production source is exactly
// signed 1b639247; no migration, seed, provider payment, or production lookup.
func TestMerchantStoreCapabilityOneVariantProbe(t *testing.T) {
	require.Equal(t, 1, MerchantStoreWriterCapability)
	schemaName := os.Getenv("MERCHANT_STORE_CAP1_PROBE_SCHEMA")
	require.True(t, regexp.MustCompile(`^lmm_merchant_store_test_[a-f0-9]{32}$`).MatchString(schemaName))
	dsn, err := merchantStoreLocalPostgresDSN(os.Getenv("MERCHANT_STORE_POSTGRES_TEST_DSN"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	u, err := url.Parse(dsn)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	query := u.Query()
	query.Set("search_path", schemaName)
	query.Set("application_name", schemaName+"_cap1")
	query.Set("statement_timeout", "10000")
	query.Set("lock_timeout", "5000")
	u.RawQuery = query.Encode()
	db, err := gorm.Open(postgres.New(postgres.Config{DSN: u.String(), PreferSimpleProtocol: true}), &gorm.Config{Logger: logger.Default.LogMode(logger.Silent)})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	sqlDB, err := db.DB()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	sqlDB.SetMaxOpenConns(2)
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = sqlDB.Close() })
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	require.NoError(t, sqlDB.PingContext(ctx))
	cancel()
	DB, LOG_DB, common.RedisEnabled = db, db, false
	usePostgresDatabaseType(t)
	t.Setenv("MERCHANT_STORE_ENCRYPTION_KEY", "C5wmMzDh1QsVZb0saEW9ulAPzVN87Boqv3DK6eIrKXc2YLfg")
	buyer, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("MERCHANT_STORE_CAP1_PROBE_BUYER"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	seller, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("MERCHANT_STORE_CAP1_PROBE_SELLER"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Positive(t, buyer)
	require.Positive(t, seller)
	productID := os.Getenv("MERCHANT_STORE_CAP1_PROBE_PRODUCT")
	product, err := GetMerchantStoreProduct(seller, productID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	status, err := GetMerchantStoreWriterGateStatus(db)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2, status.RequiredCapability)
	require.Equal(t, 1, status.WriterCapability)
	require.False(t, status.NewWritesAllowed)
	require.False(t, status.SupportsVariants)
	snapshot := func() string {
		parts := []string{}
		for _, table := range merchantStorePGTables(t, db, schemaName) {
			var rows string
			quoted := pgx.Identifier{schemaName, table}.Sanitize()
			require.NoError(t, db.Raw("SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(row_to_json(s)::text, E'\\n' ORDER BY row_to_json(s)::text),'') FROM "+quoted+" AS s").Scan(&rows).Error)
			parts = append(parts, table, rows)
		}
		hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
		return hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
	}
	before := snapshot()
	_, _, err = CreateMerchantStoreOrder(MerchantStoreCheckoutInput{BuyerID: buyer, ProductID: productID, Quantity: 1, PaymentMethod: "balance", RequestKey: "actual-capability-one-must-freeze"})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrMerchantStoreWriterFrozen)
	_, err = SaveMerchantStoreProduct(seller, productID, MerchantStoreProductInput{Title: "Must never edit", PriceQuota: product.PriceQuota, Template: product.Template, PaymentMethods: product.PaymentMethods})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrMerchantStoreWriterFrozen)
	_, err = AddMerchantStoreStock(seller, productID, []string{"MUST-NEVER-IMPORT"})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrMerchantStoreWriterFrozen)
	after := snapshot()
	require.Equal(t, before, after, "all owned-table rows remain unchanged after actual capability-one checkout/edit/import rejections")
	t.Logf("actual compiled capability=1 required=2; checkout/edit/import rejected; owned-row fingerprint before=%s after=%s", before, after)
	orderID := os.Getenv("MERCHANT_STORE_CAP1_PROBE_PAID_ORDER")
	token, err := GetMerchantStoreOrderPickupToken(buyer, orderID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	claim, err := ClaimMerchantStoreOrder(token, "", buyer)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"PAID-BEFORE-ACTIVATION"}, claim.Items)
	t.Log("actual capability-one frozen paid-order pickup passed at gate 2")
}
